/** [PCM] commonSql - selectEmployee - 사원 코드, 사원 이름 가져오기 */ SELECT VEMPLNO as "vEmplNo" , VNAME as "vName" FROM TAA2101
VRETIRE IS NULL
AND VEMPLNO LIKE '%'|| #{vEmplNo} || '%'
AND VNAME LIKE '%'|| #{vName} || '%'
/** [PCM] commonSql - selectKeyProject - 총괄 과제코드 조회 */ SELECT A.VKEYPROJECTCODE as "vKeyProjectCode" , A.VKEYPROJECTNAME as "vKeyProjectName" FROM TCZ2003 A ORDER BY A.VKEYPROJECTCODE

/** [PCM] commonSql - checkProject - 차수과제코드 체크 */ SELECT B.VPROJECTCODE as "vProjectCode" , A.VKEYPROJECTNAME as "vKeyProjectName" , A.VKEYPROJECTCODE as "vKeyProjectCode" , B.VSTARTDATE as "vStartDate" , B.VENDDATE as "vEndDate" FROM TCZ2003 A, TCZ2006 B
AND A.VKEYPROJECTCODE = B.VKEYPROJECTCODE AND B.VPROJECTSTEP = '3' AND B.VPROJECTCODE = #{vProjectCode}
/** [PCM] commonSql - selectFileSeq - 파일일련번호를 위한 Sequence 조회 */ SELECT LPAD(FILE_SEQ.NEXTVAL,3,0) as "fileSeq" FROM DUAL

/** [PCM] commonSql - selectHrDept - 인사정보 조회 - 부서 */ SELECT VTEAMCODE as "vDeptCode" , VTEAMNAME as "vDeptName" FROM TAZ2001
VUSEYN = 'Y'
AND ((VTEAMFLAG = '1' AND VTEAMCODE = #{vHighTeam}) OR (VTEAMFLAG = '2' AND VHIGHTEAM = #{vHighTeam}))
AND VTEAMFLAG IN ('1', '2')
ORDER BY VDISPLAYORDER
